policy.apply_when: Only when a legacy sim is reused, modified, rerun for promotion, or bound into a new matrix/receipt.
policy.rule: Rename the executable basename to the actual math object being simulated. If claim-layer or rosetta labels also appear in operator names, variable names, result keys, or imported API surfaces, scrub those internal names in the same touch.
policy.fence_if_not_touched: Leave untouched legacy files fenced/demoted rather than turning cleanup into the main work.

verified_bad_surfaces: docstring contains Axis 3 / Type 1 / Type 2 / Fe/Ti / Te/Fi
operator function and variable names include Ti, Fe, Te, Fi
verified_examples.actual_math_description: Hilbert-Schmidt overlap between channel-displacement outputs generated by projection, dissipation, Hamiltonian rotation, and spectral-filter maps under two orderings.

verified_bad_surfaces: docstring and comments contain Type-1/Type-2 and FeTi/TeFi labels
operator builders and dominance variables include Ti, Fe, Te, Fi
verified_examples.actual_math_description: Lindblad-plus-Kraus finite trajectory comparison under two staged operator dominance schedules; reports entropy, trace distance, and divergence.

verified_bad_surfaces: uses engine_type parameters and result name axis3_fiber_base_validation
verified_examples.actual_math_description: Finite trajectory comparison of fiber-stage and base-stage dynamics with ablations and Hopf-coordinate delta readouts.

verified_bad_surfaces: predicate and result language use flux_admissibility
z3 variables include axis3 and flux3
verified_examples.actual_math_description: z3 and SymPy Pauli-axis orientation constraint over diagonal/off-diagonal Pauli labels.

verified_bad_surfaces: selected grep pattern found no Type1/Type2/Ti/Fe/Te/Fi/axis3/flux_admissibility/engine_type hit in the sampled file
filename still contains type1 and engine and therefore must not be copied into new executable names
verified_examples.actual_math_description: Requires file-local reread on touch; sampled grep did not justify a precise internal-math rename by itself.

claim_ceiling: semantic naming touch policy only; no file rename performed and no sim promotion implied
